name: web-serif-search-hero-with-modern-house-photo-fading-into-white
title: Search hero 'Find the perfect block for your app.' in black serif with a pill search bar and a modern house photo feathered into white
whatItIs: A white page with a centred two-line black serif headline, a grey subline, a rounded search field with a magnifier and a black Search pill and, below, a photograph of a modern timber-and-glass house under a large tree whose edges fade softly into the white.
whatItMeans: Refined and calm; a feathered photo gives a search page an editorial feel.
techniques: Use a serif headline on white.
Embed a black button in a pill search bar.
Feather a photo's edges into the background.

vocabulary.definition: An image whose edges dissolve into the page.
A rounded search field with an embedded button.
A headline in a serif typeface.
Content aligned on the centre axis.
